summary: Route handler threaded the raw `version` query param to both the store provider (which canonicalizes internally) and the render call's `active_version` label, so a non-canonicalizable value silently applied no filter at the store while the UI claimed one was active (or, for a short-form value, the store filtered correctly but the label echoed the wrong string).

Fixed: version canonicalized once immediately after validation (yuzu::util::canon_version), single canonical value reused for the provider call and the render call. Independently re-verified closed by security-guardian, cpp-expert, cpp-safety, unhappy-path, consistency-auditor (all empirically, 3 via direct test execution).

No test asserted the `version` param actually reached the AppPerfFleetFn/AppPerfGroupFn provider mocks — a revert of the version-threading wiring would pass the suite unnoticed.

New TEST_CASE in test_dex_routes.cpp with capturing provider-mock lambdas asserting the exact canonical value reaches fleet/group providers. quality-engineer Gate 8 re-review: CLOSED, noted the guard-value pattern used is stricter than the sibling .device test it was modeled on.

The entire is_filtered==true render branch (filter banner, back-link, scope-selector URL preservation, per-row link suppression, filtered-empty-state fallback) had zero test coverage — every prior test called render_dex_app_perf_trend with the 6-arg form (active_version defaulting to "").

First attempt (new TEST_CASE, 4 SECTIONs) covered banner/back-link/scope-selector/per-row-suppression correctly, but quality-engineer's Gate 8 re-review found the filtered-empty-state fallback SECTION's assertion was a FALSE-GREEN: it matched the top banner's identical hx-get querystring, not the empty-state fallback link specifically — the assertion would still pass if the fallback code were deleted entirely. Superseded by dex-crosslink-F10 (see below) rather than closed directly here.

Re-fixed after F10: fallback-link assertion re-anchored on its distinct "← all versions" disp text (the banner's back-link uses "all versions →", opposite arrow/word order), which only the empty-state code path can produce. Rebuilt + full [dex] suite green (6824 assertions, 287 cases).

The forward-looking macOS note correctly named .ips procName as the anchor key but didn't name WHICH API a future collector must use; the codebase's existing KERN_PROC_ALL fallback (process_enum.cpp) uses a MAXCOMLEN-truncated p_comm that would silently mismatch for names over ~15 chars if copied as precedent.

Note expanded to name the untruncated executable-basename source (matching tar_proc_es.cpp's path_basename) and explicitly flag the MAXCOMLEN-truncated KERN_PROC_ALL/p_comm pattern as wrong to copy. cross-platform Gate 8 re-review verified both technical claims against primary source (process_enum.cpp:292-313, tar_proc_es.cpp:27-34): CLOSED.
